text: There is a conscious tension between sterility and creativity here. The sterile, empty glass-walled space outside feels almost intimidating in its perfection, silent and echoing with potential. Once inside, however, color and text burst forth onto the walls—R+D—signaling research and development, creativity sparking from clean order. I feel both dwarfed by the scale of innovation around me and subtly energized by the promise that structured spaces can incubate wild new ideas.
